_doc: Answers DevFlow's Partner Center form filler (dev store -Web) types into the submission pages.
Listing text comes from listing.json, the package from dev msix, screenshots from store/screenshots.
ageRating answers are a declaration by the publisher to IARC: the filler only enters them when
ageRatingConfirmedBy names the person who reviewed them. The final 'Submit to the Store' click happens
only with dev store -Web -Submit and autoSubmit true; otherwise the filler stops for review.

pricing._note: Free (/bin/bash) for every submission; the filler sets the $0 tier each run.

properties._privacyNote: RfScout collects nothing (PRIVACY.md). Full-trust packages must give a privacy policy URL, and Partner Center only takes the URL under "Yes", so the filler answers Yes and links the policy.

ageRating._note: Answers to the IARC questionnaire as Partner Center shows it (2026-11). Each 'match' is a unique part of the question text. A question with no entry stops the filler and is listed in out/store-web/age-questions.txt.

answers.match: interact or exchange content with other users
isn't part of the initial app download
precise physical location with other users
primarily a news or educational product
ratings obtained directly from a ratings board

ageRatingConfirmedBy: Owner (Max Power IT LLC), confirmed in chat on 2026-11-23
notesForCertification: RfScout is receive-only software for the HackRF One USB radio. Without a HackRF connected it starts and shows 'no radio'; all functions need the device. It needs the WinUSB driver (Zadig), which the listing explains. The app makes no network connections.
